# Version 4.148.0
> **First stable v4 release** · Released June 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.148.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.148.0)

> **Supersedes [4.147.0](4.147.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.148.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148. It rolls up variable and color fonts, animated WebP encoding, SKPathBuilder, explicit surface sampling, new platform assets, and a safer singleton lifecycle. This is a breaking release with font, WebAssembly, Vulkan, obsolete-API, and interop migrations to review before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **Legacy text, font, filtering, and run-buffer APIs are compile errors** — Pre-v4 obsoletes, including SKPaint text/font state, SKPaintHinting, SKFilterQuality, legacy GRBackendRenderTarget constructors, and run-buffer span methods, are removed from the reference assembly. Move text state to SKFont, filtering to SKSamplingOptions, and use the documented replacement properties and constructors. ([#4068](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4068), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114), [#4205](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4205))
- **WebAssembly native assets now require .NET 8** — Native assets for the Emscripten versions used by .NET 6 and .NET 7 are removed. Move Blazor WebAssembly and Uno WebAssembly applications to .NET 8 or later. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))
- **Tizen 32-bit native assets are removed** — The Skia engine transition removes the EOL Tizen arm and x86 native packages. Move Tizen deployments to tizen-arm64 or tizen-x64. ([#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620))
- **Parameterless SKFont uses an empty typeface** — `new SKFont()` no longer resolves the platform default typeface when text is drawn, so text measures as zero and does not render. Construct it with `SKTypeface.Default` when default-font behavior is required. ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **SKPaint.Typeface defaults to a non-null typeface** — A new SKPaint now exposes `SKTypeface.Default` instead of null. Stop using `paint.Typeface == null` as an unset check; use `IsEmpty` when that distinction is needed. ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **Missing font families fall back on Android** — `SKTypeface.FromFamilyName` now returns `SKTypeface.Default` instead of null for a missing family on Android. Use `SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily` when strict not-found detection is required. ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **SKStream.Move(long) rejects out-of-range offsets** — The long overload is obsolete and throws `OverflowException` instead of silently truncating values outside the 32-bit native range. Validate the offset and call `Move(int)`. ([#3714](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3714))
- **Vulkan Ganesh requires Vulkan 1.1** — Creating a Ganesh context for Vulkan 1.0 now terminates the process instead of returning null. Create the instance with Vulkan 1.1 or later and set `GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion` to the same supported version; use another backend on 1.0-only hardware.
- **Vulkan backend context fields are removed** — `GRVkBackendContextNative` no longer has `fMinAPIVersion`, `fInstanceVersion`, `fExtensions`, `fFeatures`, or `fOwnsInstanceAndDevice`. Remove those assignments and use `fVkExtensions`, `fDeviceFeatures`, and `fDeviceFeatures2` where applicable.
- **Vulkan YCbCr conversion shape changes** — `GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo` now uses `GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo`, whose layout includes `Components`; the old type's value-equality members are absent. Update type references, struct initialization, interop layout assumptions, and equality code. ([#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))
- **SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose is read-only** — Subclasses can no longer change `IgnorePublicDispose` after construction because its protected setter is removed. Supply the intended disposal behavior through the constructor path. ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080))
- **Assembly version advances to 4.x** — SkiaSharp.dll now reports assembly version 4.148.0.0 instead of 3.119.0.0. Update strong-name binding redirects and any hard-coded assembly-version checks. ([#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125))

## Engine

- **Skia advances from m119 to m148** — The bundled engine adds image orientation, HDR and wide-gamut improvements, filter fixes, immutable paths through SKPathBuilder, and the RF16 single-channel half-float color type. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125))
- **Variable and color fonts arrive** — SKTypeface and HarfBuzzSharp can query variation axes, select design positions and named instances, and choose or override color font palettes. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **m147 correctness fixes included** — The engine includes fixes for SkRuntimeEffect thread safety, SkRP optimizer accounting, and malformed SkRegion data. ([#4044](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4044))

## API Surface

- **Animated WebP encoding** — SKWebpEncoder can encode frame sequences with durations into animated WebP output, with span-based frame input and stream overloads. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771))
- **Explicit sampling for surface and bitmap draws** — SKSurface.Draw, SKCanvas.DrawSurface, and SKCanvas.DrawBitmap gain SKSamplingOptions overloads for selecting filtering and mipmapping. ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114))
- **Memory-backed stream data access** — SKStream.GetData() returns ref-counted SKData when the stream can expose its contents directly. ([#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **New graphics and document APIs** — Adds SKColorSpace.CreateCicp, SKDocument.CreateXps options, per-resource GRContext.Flush overloads, SKMaskFilter.CreateShader, and HDR color types including RF16. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001), [#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125))
- **Correct HarfBuzz color representation** — HBColor models hb_color_t channel ordering and provides conversions to and from SKColor and SKColorF. ([#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000))

## Bug Fixes

- **Pixel spans honor actual row stride** — SKPixmap and SKBitmap now calculate span lengths and coordinates from RowBytes, fixing non-square images and subsets that share a wider parent buffer. ([#4128](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4128), [#4148](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4148))
- **Font initialization and lookup corrected** — Default typeface resolution no longer crashes on Android API 36, variable-font spans handle undersized buffers, and ContainsGlyphs avoids infinite recursion. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742), [#3744](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3744))
- **SKPath finalization no longer crashes** — SKPath avoids flushing a builder that has already been finalized when garbage collection tears the objects down in either order. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796))
- **Platform view and projection failures fixed** — Android SKGLView renders after tab or navigation reattachment, and .NET 9 WinUI consumers can resolve the projection assembly. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076), [#4084](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4084))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Singleton initialization and ownership reworked** — Lazy per-type initialization removes static-constructor cycles, shared native singletons are not freed by managed wrappers, and wrappers stay alive across native calls. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080))
- **Native compatibility checks run on first interop use** — Consumers can configure native-library resolution before SkiaSharp checks the native version, while every P/Invoke path remains guarded. ([#4133](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4133))

## Platform

- **Linux Bionic assets for x64 and arm64** — Dedicated SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp native packages support Linux environments built on Android's Bionic libc. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217))
- **Tizen gains 64-bit assets** — Native packages now include the official tizen-x64 and tizen-arm64 runtime identifiers. ([#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620))
- **Apple libraries use base 26.0 TFMs** — Versioned library TFMs target Apple 26.0 so consumers are not forced onto a specific later Xcode 26 workload. ([#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798))

## Security

- **libexpat security hardening** — Updates the bundled libexpat to 2.8.1 with upstream security hardening. ([#4079](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4079))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0

Updates the bundled engine from HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.5 to 14.2.0, with improved OpenType shaping and CFF2 subsetting, and includes variable-font controls, color font palettes, and HBColor conversions.

## Preview 1 (April 28, 2026)

Introduces Skia m147, SKPathBuilder, variable and color fonts, explicit surface sampling, Linux Bionic assets, and 64-bit Tizen support.
